name: Chatpata Bhindi Aloo
description: Quick and simple spicy okra and potato stir-fry by Chef Sanjyot Keer (Your Food Lab).
recipeIngredient: a handful of fresh coriander, chopped
recipeInstructions: Wash the lady fingers and dry them with a clean kitchen towel. Place on a plate and let them dry under the fan for 5-10 minutes.
Once dry, cut them into thick dice and transfer to a bowl.
Cut the potato into same-sized dice and place in water so it doesn't discolour.
Cut the onions into thick slices and transfer to a bowl.
Set a kadhai over high flame and add the oil. Heat until it reaches smoking point, then lower the flame and let it cool slightly.
Add the cumin seeds, garlic, green chillies and asafoetida. Stir well and cook the garlic over medium-low flame for 1-2 minutes.
Add the sliced onions and cook over high flame until translucent.
Add the potatoes and cook over high flame for 2-3 minutes, then cover and cook over low flame for 4-5 minutes until almost cooked.
Add all the powdered spices and kasuri methi, stir well and cook over low flame for 1-1.5 minutes.
Add the lady fingers, stir, then cover and cook over medium-low flame until cooked.
Taste and adjust salt, then add garam masala and fresh coriander. Serve.
